numbers._note: M8 step 1b (docs/DESIGN.md, 'World generation, details'; the user's decisions 2026-10-24, the exact numbers my picks, to confirm): dead_share, of the mounds how many are dead (real surveys: a third to a half); sizes, weights of full, half-grown and young mounds (living: the real age mix, mostly full; dead: the size they had stood to); dead_stages, weights of freshly dead (0-3 days), wearing (3-12), slumping (12-30) and old grassy humps (35-200); hump_woods, of the old humps how many have trees or a thicket on them (real mound islands); aardvark_burrows, of the old humps how many an aardvark has dug a burrow into, down to the old nest (0 turns it off); hump_grass, greener grass on the old humps (false turns it off).
